// diagnostic

E0057

This closure uses the retired `take(...)` capture prefix.

What

This closure uses the retired `take(...)` capture prefix.

Why

Escaping closures infer ownership. Copyable values copy at closure creation, and other owned values move. A capture prefix cannot create a second owner.

Fix

remove `take(...)` and use the captured names directly.
